assumption: every status assumes code an agent runs cannot write the control directory or the store; on a single OS account that holds only for the agent's tool calls (docs/trust.md)

statuses.enforced: the factory refuses or fails closed when the principle is violated; tagged tests prove it
statuses.partial: a working mechanism covers the core of the principle; the stated limits remain
statuses.documented: described for operators; nothing in this repository enforces it

principles.name: Humans own intent
principles.mechanism: runs refuse tasks without a human intent approval bound to the task file's digest

principles.name: Admit only verifiable work
principles.mechanism: admission requires acceptance cases mapped to requirements, decided non-functionals, protected tests that exist; refusal is recorded

principles.name: Research and plan, scaled to the task
principles.mechanism: medium and large tasks run a read-only planner and stop for plan approval bound to the plan digest
principles.limits: plan quality is judged by the approving human

principles.name: Repository as system of record
principles.mechanism: knowledge lives in control; the proof pack (plan, evidence, decisions) is committed with every release
principles.limits: the factory does not maintain or check freshness of the product's own docs beyond stale-link scans

principles.name: Context is a budget
principles.mechanism: generated map with a line budget (run refused when exceeded); knowledge listed and read on demand
principles.limits: on-demand reading depends on the agent following the map

principles.name: State outside the context window
principles.mechanism: atomic run state, hash-linked events, progress file, resume and explicit stale-lock recovery

principles.name: Isolated, focused context per step
principles.mechanism: planner, builder and reviewer run as separate processes with their own briefs and tool lists
principles.limits: the gain of adding a role is not measured automatically

principles.name: Own the control flow
principles.mechanism: fixed stage graph in code; an agent's message never sets a status

principles.name: Fast feedback, cheapest check first
principles.mechanism: configured gate order, stop at the first failing gate, remediation text written for the agent

principles.name: Bounded runs and escalation
principles.mechanism: attempt limit, per-run and daily spend caps, agent timeouts, kill switch read on every tool call, needs-human with owner, question and default deadline
principles.limits: scripted and command agents can overshoot the run cap once (Claude Code enforces it per call); command agents report no cost, so only time limits bind them

principles.name: Deterministic before judgement
principles.mechanism: review runs only after every deterministic gate passed; the reviewer brief excludes the builder's narrative

principles.name: Protected and hidden oracle
principles.mechanism: integrity gate on protected files; hook denies edits to them; holdouts outside the workspace, optionally encrypted at rest, run by a separate process, counts-only feedback, leaked sets retired
principles.limits: policy-level isolation in one OS account: code the agent runs (tests) can read files the user can; sealed holdouts reduce this to the factory process's key

principles.name: Evidence over assertions; fail closed
principles.mechanism: three-state gate results; missing tests, empty results or incomplete evaluator output are NOT-EARNED; any non-PASS blocks acceptance; a change with no allowed write or command decided by the policy hook is NOT-EARNED (boundary evidence); a configuration that would skip a gate silently is refused

principles.name: Independent, adversarial review
principles.mechanism: read-only reviewer in a fresh process told to refute; findings must cite a real file:line; high-severity findings fail the attempt, the rest are listed for the approver
principles.limits: no automatic planted-defect calibration of the reviewer yet

principles.name: Layered proof
principles.mechanism: fail-to-pass tests must fail on the base commit; repeat runs must agree; light mutation testing on changed lines
principles.limits: mutation operators are textual and JavaScript-oriented

principles.name: Product observable to the agent
principles.mechanism: observe commands (stack profile or factory.json) appear in the map and join the builder's exact command allowlist; the agent runs the visible tests itself
principles.limits: no per-run app instance, telemetry query tools or digital twins

principles.name: Maintainability as a verification target
principles.mechanism: dependency-direction, duplication and file-size sensors as a gate
principles.limits: rules must be written for each codebase; JavaScript import detection only

principles.name: No lethal trifecta
principles.mechanism: configuration with a role holding private data, untrusted content and external communication is refused
principles.limits: capabilities are declared by the configuration's author

principles.name: Least privilege in a disposable workspace
principles.mechanism: fresh git worktree per run, scrubbed environment, dontAsk mode with exact command allow-rules, hook confinement to the workspace, data-boundary globs, no network tools, boundary evidence required before any gate is trusted
principles.limits: no containers or OS-level egress control on this platform; the generic command adapter has no tool-level confinement, so the AI policy must allow it explicitly and the proof pack says so (docs/trust.md)

principles.name: Separation of duties
principles.mechanism: agent identities cannot approve; the requester cannot approve their release; two-human tiers need two distinct approvers; approvals bind the proof digest
principles.limits: identities are asserted, not authenticated; approval records are plain files in the store (docs/trust.md)

principles.name: Factory configuration is a supply chain
principles.mechanism: runs refuse a configuration digest no human approved; config change mid-run stops the run; agents cannot write factory files
principles.limits: approvals are local records, not signed attestations; agent-run code in the same OS account could change control files between runs (docs/trust.md)

principles.name: Standard tracing
principles.mechanism: OTel-GenAI-shaped spans for workflow, stages, agents, tools and gates; content capture off by default
principles.limits: spans are written as JSONL, not exported to a collector

principles.name: Traceability and provenance
principles.mechanism: requirement → evidence table, versions and digests in the proof pack, Assisted-by trailer, hash-linked events

principles.name: Cost per accepted change
principles.mechanism: cost per role and run from agent output, failed attempts counted, cost per accepted change and failed share in metrics
principles.limits: agents that do not report cost are flagged as unknown

principles.name: Outcome and stability metrics, visible
principles.mechanism: report and static dashboard lead with acceptance, first-pass, change-failure, escaped defects, cost per accepted change, overfit gap

principles.name: Risk-tiered, earned autonomy
principles.mechanism: change classes map to auto / one-human / two-humans; the most restrictive effective tier over every class a change touches decides, and unclassified files keep the default tier; earnable classes gain a tier after clean releases; incidents demote every class the change touched; policy limits unattended classes

principles.name: Reversible delivery and production feedback
principles.mechanism: release is a new branch with a recorded rollback target, never pushed; incidents link back to runs
principles.limits: no canary, feature flags or production monitoring

principles.name: Fix the delivery system first
principles.mechanism: doctor checks git, clean tree, CI config, tools and deterministic tests; runs refuse without a recent passing check
principles.limits: does not measure the value stream or CI capacity

principles.name: Protect human review capacity
principles.mechanism: new runs refused while the review queue is at its limit; diff budget gate; proof pack lists what was not verified

principles.name: Engineer comprehension
principles.mechanism: release approval must cite the current proof-pack digest; plan and evidence travel with the change
principles.limits: the factory cannot check that a person understood the change

principles.name: AI policy and accountability
principles.mechanism: approved models and tools, unattended classes, data-boundary globs and approver list enforced; every approval names a person

principles.name: Measured, supervised self-improvement
principles.mechanism: registered experiments with held-out audit tasks, results from real runs matched by config digest, graders off-limits, proposal only
principles.limits: no automatic candidate generation, canary or rollback of factory versions

principles.name: Entropy control
principles.mechanism: gc scans the target with the maintainability sensors and stale-link checks and drafts cleanup tasks
principles.limits: no scheduler; drafts need a human to add acceptance cases

principles.name: Everything earns its place
principles.mechanism: gate statistics (evaluated, first failures, NOT-EARNED, time); this conformance registry with tagged and mechanism-off tests

principles.name: Portable core, stack-specific templates
principles.mechanism: stack profiles and agent adapters (Claude Code, generic command, scripted) behind one interface; the command adapter drives the same pipeline in tests; the Claude Code adapter was validated with real runs
principles.limits: only the Node profile is validated end to end; the generic-exit profile is untested
